action.objective: Recapture the d4 pawn with exd4, keeping material and defending against Black's ...Bh3 battery.
action.rationale: e3d4 is the sole commit_ready move: verified at effective depth 4 with exact score 127, full mate-in-one safety check (no mating reply), and tactical refutation not_found. It wins the d4 pawn, opens the e3 pawn toward the center, and the PV ...Bg4 Qxg4 Qxh1+ Kc2 shows Black's bishop swaps leave White's queen active. No other move matched verification; committing the verified leader without continuation given residual uncertainty.
